text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Are you ready, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Tsuyoshi & Teio
text_block_list.text: "The 'Who Looks More Like the Student Council President!?' Championship"~!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"We'd like you to act as the judge, Trainer!
Fairly and strictly!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Alright, I'll go first!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"‘There is no path before me. Therefore, forge onward!
I shall carve the path myself!’"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
So cool~!!
That's President Rudolf when she runs to a T!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Still... hmm... President Rudolf is
so calm and kind, which is great too...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: For instance, look!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: "President Rudolf's Deep in Thought Pose!"
choice_data_list: This one really captures their features too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, totally, totally!!
The Prez looks so cool when she's deep in thought, right?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
She must always be caring so deeply
about everyone just like that.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah! But wait!
Speaking of being serious, after school the other day—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there's the Prez!
I was wondering where you went, and here you are—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Today's teitetsu (horseshoes) are itetsu (freezing)~~ ...Just kidding.
...Because teitetsu sounds like itetsu...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
How playful!
I find that to be part of her charm too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
Well, to be honest, I don't really get puns anyway.
choice_data_list: You two are quite observant, huh.
You two are quite observant, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: And then, and then? Trainer, which of us do you think looked more like President Rudolf?

Both Tokai Teio and Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi captured the essence of Symboli Rudolf quite well.
Therefore—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!? No, you can't.
How are we supposed to judge like that?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Alright, round one is a draw!
Next up is—
(SLIDE-CLATTER!)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ah, Prez!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me.
I didn't mean to eavesdrop, but...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Geez! You should've told me the President was here~! She heard everything~♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I was delivering documents to the trainers. I shall leave them here.

As expected of the great Symboli Rudolf.
Just as I was admiring her composure as she turned to leave without being shaken in the slightest—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —Please wait, President Rudolf!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Everything I said here about how I feel about the President
was completely genuine, and I want you to hear more of it!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
The President always shines like the sun...
and I want to take even one step closer to being like her!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
So... that's why!
The President who's like that—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I love it!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: *cough*, *splutter*, *dofweaahhh*!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...When you're that straightforward...
Even I can't help but feel a bit embarrassed.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
I have received your feelings, loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
However, please do not forget.
It is you, carrying the future, who is my shining sun.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... The Prez was so cool!
Way to go, Tsuru-chan!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, ehehehe...♪
choice_data_list: You got your feelings across, didn't you?
I guess the look-alike contest is settled with the real deal showing up.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes!!
Even though it got kind of chaotic in the heat of the moment...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
“That's precisely why there's
only one thing left for us to do next!”

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I want my strength to reach the President!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Nothing really beats how cool the real deal is, huh~.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Still, I got to learn about the President's expectations.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"I want to become someone cool like that
for real one day!"
